description: Same B39 warm start, same B41 data/steps/particles/viability. Only the event-kernel target_next label changes. Frontier is the frozen B41 D0 row. This job fine-tunes canonical-singleton and random-singleton for 2 epochs, then Table1 n=20 valid-terminal eval.
hypothesis: Training the event kernel on the dependency-ready frontier set beats a single canonical next event and a random linear-extension next event on real-5 Acc@0.65 any@20.
claim_if_pass: order-free edit-frontier learning is a method contribution
claim_if_fail: frontier NLL is not a contribution; do not rename B41 as order-free edit-frontier learning
canonical_rule: among dependency-ready gold events, keep the smallest event-layout index
random_singleton_rule: among dependency-ready gold events, keep one uniform draw; prefix sampling stays B41 random linear extension
